content: The test image shows a tomato leaf with prominent concentric ring patterns (ringspots) - lighter green circular/oval rings against darker green tissue, with some small necrotic brown spots. This ring spot pattern is the hallmark of Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus (TSWV).

The reference TSWV image shows necrotic/purplish spots with bronzing - a different presentation. However, TSWV is known to cause concentric ring spots on leaves, which is exactly what the test image shows. The distinctive concentric lighter-green rings on the leaf surface (ring spot pattern) is the hallmark symptom of TSWV. CMV can also cause mottling but typically doesn't produce these well-defined concentric rings.
